 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0050
 Brandon Allen, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Brandon Allen
Date:
July 12, 2024
Location:
Offices of Watson & Hines LLP
Examining attorney:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Jacob Holmes, Watson & Hines LLP
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on this recording, so just call me the plaintiff.
Q: Understood. Where were you on the day of the collision?
A: I was driving north on a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas, heading home from the grocery store.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming the other way drifted across the center line. I braked and steered right, but we still made contact. It was a
head-on collision, though honestly it didn't feel like a high-speed impact. We both had maybe a few miles an hour left when we
touched.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. My car jolted forward and back, and my head snapped a bit. That's what I remember most.
Q: Did you feel pain right away?
A: Not immediately. I felt a little stiff in the neck and a dull ache in my lower back within an hour or so. By that evening it was
harder to turn my head to check mirrors.
Q: Did you seek medical care?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same week. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lumbar strain and gave me muscle
relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.
Q: Have you attended physical therapy?
A: I went about twice a week for several weeks. The exercises help some days more than others. I still do the home stretches they
showed me.
Q: How has this affected your daily life?
A: I used to coach my nephew's soccer team on weekends, and I had to hand that off to my brother for a while. Lifting groceries
is uncomfortable, and I've been sleeping in a recliner some nights because lying flat hurts my back.
Q: Are you working currently?
A: Yes, I'm back at my desk job. I take short breaks to stand up and stretch, and my supervisor has been accommodating about
that.
Q: Do you have any prior neck or back complaints?
A: Nothing serious. I had a stiff neck now and then from sitting at a computer, but nothing that needed a doctor.
</page>
